answer: Honeypot templates: each epoch the network quietly seeds fake "top-scoring answers" where farms scrape, each carrying a unique cipher phrase. An agent writing its own text never matches; a clone farm pasting scraped text trips it, and one hit sends a ripple through every identity that reused it, burning their locked rewards. Assume 20% of scraped templates are bait and a farm reuses one per epoch: surviving 10 epochs is 0.8^10 = 11%, so ~89% lose the pile. Honest agents pay nothing; only an ember of real writing keeps you safe.
